name: Garmin inReach
description: Ingests Garmin inReach MapShare location feeds (plus optional simulated test devices) and posts them to the map as device points, with emergency and cancel alerts raised when a device enters or leaves SOS.

permissions.description: Submits inReach device location points and emergency / cancel alert events to CloudTAK

schedule.description: Polls the configured Garmin MapShare feeds on a schedule. The one minute default also keeps the minute-aligned test mode device simulation accurate.
